failure_modes.evidence: In hop 2, the solver summary states: 'the claim that John Fecknam was the last abbot of Westminster Abbey cannot be verified from any of the provided passages' despite passage [2] from hop 1 explicitly containing 'John Feckenham (c. 1515 – October, 1584), also known as John Howman of Feckingham and later John de Feckenham or John Fecknam, was an English churchman, the last abbot of Westminster.'
